segmentation.definition: Boundary F1 over the boundaries between sentences inside each paragraph: a sentence end and the next sentence's start, compared at exact positions after trimming whitespace. Paragraph edges are fixed by the fixture, so they are not counted.

acceptance.target: mean share of key terms in the top 10 >= 0.50 over 5 documents
the out-of-topic cooking article is unclassified (result: held-out fixtures unclassified)

notes: Indicative only: the gold sets are the requirement minimums (P9-9). Every rate carries its denominator and a Wilson 95% interval; a target met only at the point estimate is reported that way.

The 20 public documents both calibrate the unclassified threshold and are assessed by AC-09.1, so that side is not independent. The held-out out-of-topic fixtures were not used to choose the threshold.
Category scores are cosine similarities between a document's mean chunk vector and each description vector, not probabilities.
DDIA and every other document outside the manifest's evaluation scope were not read.
